caption:
Your brain treats planning as progress — the research, the lists, the imagined routine all produce the same reward as starting. So the start never comes. The One Alarm breaks the pattern. DM "DETOX" for the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save this for the next Monday that was supposed to be different.

#overthinking #springreset #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: you've planned your spring reset 4 times. you haven't started.
